title: DurabilitySettings
description: Data file content/durability/settings.json (D711 section 5, plan D1008, values TH147): how long things last by their material class. A class is found by TRUE properties (the first that fits); a thing lasts base_hours, its wear grows by one per tick plus the factors for each wet, frost, hot and frost-on-wet nature takt (R51); at 1000 permille it is gone. Things of the world start get a seeded age, so they do not all end on one day.

base_hours.description: Game hours a thing of this class lasts in plain conditions; null = it does not wear away by time (stone, fired clay).

wet_permille.description: Extra ageing per wet nature takt, in permille of the takt (2000 = a wet takt ages three times as fast). Omitted = 0.

frost_permille.description: Extra ageing per frost takt. Omitted = 0.

heat_permille.description: Extra ageing per hot takt. Omitted = 0.

wet_frost_permille.description: Extra ageing per takt of frost on something wet (cracks). Omitted = 0.
